profiles.name: catalog
profiles.definition: Native catalog capability/0.10: explicit original UMF preparation; current compatible acceptance and unchanged/historical retry; exact original reports; complete native catalog view; person-scoped module/source reads; caller-owned transaction; no administrative installation or module grants. Compatible non-key scalar refinement admits unfaceted to/from supported signed64 or decimal(18,4) or decimal(18,2) facets with native existing-value validation and exact typed property.facets refusal counts; key facet evolution remains unsupported. Name-only Field presentation changes retain property and business-key identities; occupied prior names and retained-value collisions refuse. Selected UMF0.8 source-reference reports retain exact document bytes once in acceptedInput; document title is retained metadata. Native60 registration moves valid retained values into new absent-allowed non-key scalar/flat properties, increments each affected object once, and retains original registration-owned effects and complete history. Invalid candidates refuse by qualified property and count; key rebinding remains unsupported. Native61 also admits new required non-key scalar/flat fields when all existing objects have valid non-null retained candidates. Missing/null candidates return property.required counts and invalid candidates property.rebind_value counts before persistence; empty containers remain present values. Original stored event profiles select report/history attribution, preserving older optional-only reports. Native62 adds new alternate keys over existing required singular string/integer/decimal/boolean/binary properties. Existing keys/primary selection remain unchanged and new owner-local numbers follow the retained maximum. Original UMF receipts bind locked candidates, duplicate refusals count all participating objects by qualified key before changes, and registration-owned key effects appear in report0.4. Pure key backfill preserves object version/revision/timestamps; original reports retain their own format and exact bytes. Native63 also admits genuinely new required singular scalar fields as components of genuinely new alternate keys in the same registration. Original retained cells are validated before effects, rebound once, and encoded by UMF with their planned facets. These registrations use rebind/0.3 and key-backfill/0.2; original stored reports retain their earlier profiles. Changes to existing keys remain unsupported. Explicit Bun selection is available on acceptance. Native64 adds bounded acyclic nested array/map properties and retained cells, complete original descendant definition/read dependencies and exact scalar leaves; prior profile definitions remain retained. Record/composed ownership and descendant evolution remain unsupported.
profiles.policyDefinition: Native catalog policy/0.2: ordinary authenticated person; registrar membership for acceptance, original reports and complete catalog view; current module reader or writer for person-scoped catalog and accepted document reads; exact installed release; READ COMMITTED; no installation administration authority. Rebinding requires affected module writer and complete original property/item read authority. Any report containing rebind data requires current original owner/property/item readers on acceptance, replay, unchanged and report reads, including after objects are deleted.

profiles.name: direct_read
profiles.definition: Native direct read capability/0.6: rootless exact scalar object identity/key/live pages; independent directed edge identity/relationship pages; authority receipt visibility; committed native import provenance after deletion; current document-qualified module authority; read-only READ COMMITTED supported; no structured ownership, general historical records or compiler execution. Optional registered feed-consumer reached comparison returns true/false only for valid authorized issued receipts against committed protected checkpoints, with separate comparison profile. One-call live 1–3 qualified independent directed relationship hops return unique numeric-ordered terminal scalar objects with path-local cycle exclusion, or limited/not-established with no records and restart. Logical attempted-state/result/byte limits and ordinary deadlines; no exact backend allocation guarantee or staged snapshot resume. Complete object values additionally admit one-level arrays/maps of required exact scalar items using original revision-qualified item definitions and current item-module read authority; sequences ordered and maps exact-key unique; no owned values. Native64 adds bounded acyclic nested array/map properties and retained cells, complete original descendant definition/read dependencies and exact scalar leaves; prior profile definitions remain retained. Record/composed ownership and descendant evolution remain unsupported.
profiles.policyDefinition: Native direct-read policy/0.1: ordinary authenticated person; current document-qualified reader or writer for object, property, relationship and endpoint dependencies used by each supported read; no writer-only gate; READ COMMITTED and supported read-only transactions; exact installed release; no raw table privileges. Current required item-definition module readers are included in pre-observation and final dependency checks; key/page scope refuses before observing protected routes when complete object interpretation is unauthorized.
